fact: Cabinet approved the Seychelles National Addressing System Bill, 2026, a framework for a standardised, digitally enabled national addressing system with a National Addressing Department and a National Addressing Database Unit, per State House.
Vice President Pillay said Seychelles has no proper addressing system and that the postcode in use is simply four zeros.
The Seychelles Postal Regulator says Cabinet approved implementing a National Addressing and Postcode System and adopted the S42 address standard, with the legal framework still being drafted.
